module.title: Theme toggle
module.description: The ThemeToggle renderer and its options.

ui.name: theme-toggle
ui.summary: Switches the document between the light and dark themes.
ui.guidance: It is the one shell control with no useful no-script behaviour: the theme is a client preference, and only the browser knows which way "system" points. The pre-paint script in the document head sets the initial class, so the page never flashes the wrong theme; this control flips it and persists the result. Its Alpine controller (themeToggle) is registered by the shell in static/app.js rather than in a module fragment, because it shares persistTheme and the pre-paint initialisation with the shell.
